title: Release D: canonical URL deduplication
summary: Normalize trailing-slash variants before IndexNow batch deduplication. Add no-retry and canonical payload checks; no deployment or flag change.

changes.detail: Collapse slashless and trailing-slash variants into the storefront canonical URL before one batch submission.
Regression cases verify canonical deduplication and no retry on rejected or uncertain submissions.
